name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: A Fallen Soldier’s Angst, Love and Longing to Return Home From the Iran War
changes.summary: Sgt. Michael Emmanuel Swinton was killed in recent days, one of 18 U.S. soldiers who have lost their lives since the beginning of the war in Iran.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: U.S.-Iran strikes escalate, affecting global energy markets, Trump imposes double-digit tariffs on dozens of countries, Vigil held in Madison, Wisconsin, for man killed by police.

changes.title: Brent Crude Oil Prices Top $100 as Conflict With Iran Drags On
changes.summary: Stocks in Asia were down following a sell-off in the U.S. markets over soaring oil prices, rising borrowing costs and worries about the technology industry.

changes.title: Iran War and Trump’s Tariffs Threaten a Resilient U.S. Economy
changes.summary: As renewed fighting with Iran sends oil and gas prices soaring, President Trump has imposed new global tariffs that could push up prices further.

changes.title: Concerns over U.S. weapons getting depleted as U.S. and Iran continue to trade strikes
changes.summary: As the U.S. builds up forces in the Middle East amid the ongoing war with Iran, there's concern among some officials that U.S. weapons may be getting depleted. It comes as President Trump has threatened new escalations and as the U.S. and Iran continue to trade strikes. Charlie D'Agata reports.

changes.title: How Trump's threat of a "massive attack" on Iran could unfold
changes.summary: President Trump said he is considering a "massive attack" on Iran as fighting ramps up. CBS News' Charlie D'Agata explains how a U.S. military attack on Iran could unfold.

changes.title: Gas, groceries and back-to-school items are where shoppers might see higher oil prices surface
changes.summary: Already feeling pinched since the start of the Iran war, consumers are likely to feel more pain ahead as oil prices pushed past $100 a barrel Thursday amid renewed fighting and military strikes that have left global oil supplies stranded in the Middle East.

changes.title: Mixed close on Wall Street amid U.S.-Iran fighting, new Trump tariffs
changes.summary: Stock markets closed mixed on Friday as the Iran war continues to upend energy prices. CBS News MoneyWatch correspondent Kelly O'Grady has more.

changes.title: Trump says U.S. 'locked and loaded' to attack Iran as concerns grow over rising costs at home
changes.summary: NBC’s Monica Alba, Brian Cheung, Courtney Kube and Richard Engel share their latest reporting on new strikes in Iran and the economic impact of a growing war. Retired Vice Admiral Kevin Donegan reacts to the president’s comments, saying he sees a “potential path to escalation" in Iran.

changes.title: Trump takes questions on Iran and cyclosporiasis outbreak during White House event
changes.summary: During an event on nuclear innovation, President Trump fielded questions from reporters on the war with Iran and threats about potential targets and the outbreak of cyclosporiasis. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on what the president had to say about the issues facing the administration.
